captionBasis: This form squashes adjacent printed captions into one run in the text stream ("ORICourt addressCourt telephone no.", "CHARGE CODE(S)DATE OF"). A printed-caption check cannot be run on them, and a match loose enough to accept the scrambled text would pass on anything. Captions here are the AcroForm field names SCAO authored, which are meaningful and section-keyed, plus the printed section heading. The scrambled extraction at each widget's own coordinate is recorded beside it as evidence, for the reviewer who reads the paper.
